label: Своего / Своему
description: A 10-sentence card for свой declined across genders and cases.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine dative своему. Свой agrees with the possessed noun and points back to the subject. Своему is the masculine dative form, matching брату; since я am the caller, свой is used, not его.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental своей. Своей is the feminine instrumental form, agreeing with дочерью. The subject она is the possessor, so свой rather than её is required.
Strategic focus: Plural prepositional своих. Своих is the plural prepositional form after о, agreeing with детях. Because мы are the subject and the parents, свой is used in place of их.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental своими. Своими is the plural instrumental form, agreeing with руками. The subject он acted, so свой points back to him.
Strategic focus: Masculine genitive своего. Своего is the masculine genitive form under negation, agreeing with паспорта. The same-subject rule applies, so свой replaces мой in the reflexive sense.
Strategic focus: Feminine dative своей. Своей is the feminine dative form, agreeing with подруге. Since она is the writer, свой is used instead of её.
Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional своём. Своём is the masculine prepositional form after о, agreeing with проекте. The subject мы own the project, so свой is correct.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental своим. Своим is the masculine instrumental form, agreeing with результатом. Because он is the subject and possessor, свой is used, not его.
Strategic focus: Plural dative своим. Своим is the plural dative form, agreeing with соседям. The subject они are the helpers, so свой points back to them rather than их.
Strategic focus: Feminine prepositional своей. Своей is the feminine prepositional form after о, agreeing with семье. The subject я is the possessor, so свой is the reflexive choice.
